page_title: RSO 2-1 ESP | Real Sociedad v Espanyol 09/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Javier Alberola shows a yellow card to Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) for his blatant foul.
90+1' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90+1' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
89' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
89' The referee blows his whistle as Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in his challenge.
87' A substitution has been made. Fernando Calero goes off and Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) comes on.

84' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the left side of the target. The assist goes to Jon Ander Olasagasti and the score changes to 2:1.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alvaro Aguado departs the field of play to be replaced by Rafel Bauza (Espanyol).
80' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a change. Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) replaces Luka Sucic.
80' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
76' A cross from Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) will replace Sheraldo Becker.
74' The attendance for today's match is 29478.
74' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
71' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) whips the ball into the box and Ander Barrenetxea takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) for Roberto Fernandez Jaen.
69' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
68' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
68' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad win a corner kick.
67' What a great touch by Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
67' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
62' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Pablo Marin as he is replaced by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad).
62' Imanol Alguacil prepares a substitution. Orri Oskarsson is replaced by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad).
62' Substitution. Sergio Gomez did his best and is replaced by Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad).
62' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
61' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
61' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. It will be a corner kick for Real Sociedad.
61' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) attempted to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but with no success.
60' Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul after Fernando Calero (Espanyol) hacks down one of his opponents.
58' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
53' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Javi Puado (Espanyol) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Alex Remiro no chance!
53' Javi Puado (Espanyol) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
51' Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Javier Alberola lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.

51' Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Javier Alberola with no other option than to blow for a foul. The referee makes the call - penalty to Espanyol!
50' Javi Puado (Espanyol) touches the ball with his hand.
46' Manolo Gonzalez makes a switch. Jofre is coming on in place of Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) at the start of the second period.
46' Substitution. Exposito will be replaced by Alejo Veliz (Espanyol).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Javi Puado (Espanyol) jumps into a tackle and Javier Alberola signals a foul.
42' Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar.
42' Corner kick. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity.
42' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad). Real Sociedad will take a corner kick.
40' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol) was quite harsh and Javier Alberola didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
35' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad).
34' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that crashes into the defensive wall. The opposition's goalkeeper set it up perfectly.
33' Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Real Sociedad have a free kick from a promising distance.
33' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
31' Espanyol are ruled offside.
26' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Javier Alberola has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
19' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
18' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the left post is smartly dealt with by Joan Garcia.
14' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Joan Garcia intercepts the ball.
14' A cross by Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
11' A precise first-time shot by Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by a defender.
10' Javi Puado (Espanyol) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
5' Real Sociedad fail to score from a corner as Joan Garcia (Espanyol) leaps to collect the ball.
1' 1 - 0 Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) collects a sweet pass inside the penalty box and smashes the ball inside the left post. What a clinical finish!
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Espanyol will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Javier Alberola.
